Um fluxo divide uma tarefa grande em eta: A workflow splits a big task into steps, each one on a model: for example, Opus plans, Sonnet builds and tests. It costs more than a single reply, so Clave always shows the steps and the cost estimate and waits for your OK.
Desligado, ele faz tudo sozinho num mode: When off, it does everything on its own with a single model. When on, it can propose a workflow when the task is big, and nothing runs without your OK.
Para usar: escolha um fluxo e descreva a: To use one: pick a workflow and describe the task, or type /fluxo in the message box. You can also just ask ("do this with a workflow") and Claude sets up the steps.
Para que serve, em uma frase: What it is for, in one sentence
O que a pessoa precisa dizer ao usar (ex: What the user needs to say when using it (e.g. the month and the spreadsheet)
O que esta etapa faz e o que deve entreg: What this step does and what it should deliver
Rodar ao mesmo tempo que a etapa anterio: Run at the same time as the previous step
Um agente é um especialista com instruçõ: An agent is a specialist with its own instructions, model and tools. Each workflow step can be done by one. They use the same format as Claude Code: files in .claude/agents (the folder's) or ~/.claude/agents (personal).
O que ele faz e quando usar: What it does and when to use it
Você é ... Seu trabalho é ... No fim, en: You are ... Your job is ... At the end, deliver ...
Fica em <code>~/.claude/agents</code> e: Stored in ~/.claude/agents and applies in every folder (and in Claude Code).
{n} fluxo(s), {total} no total. O gasto: {n} workflow(s), {total} in total. Each workflow's spend also counts toward the monthly cap and shows up in Usage & spend as "workflow".
